H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H623: Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H2790: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1993: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H6191: properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense)
H5475: a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret
H3289: to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve
H6845: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H3582: to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H1285: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
H3772: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H123: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him
H3459: a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael
H4124: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants
H1905: a Hagrite or member of a certain Arabian clan
H5983: Ammon, a son of Lot; also his posterity and their country
H6002: Amalek, a descendant of Esau; also his posterity and their country
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H804: Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire
H3867: properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H2220: the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H4080: Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants
H5516: Sisera, the name of a Canaanitish king and of one of the Nethinim
H2985: Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings
H5158: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H5081: properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant)
H6159: Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H5257: properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H3423: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1534: a wheel; by analogy, a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H1197: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be(-come) brutish
H3293: a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees)
H3852: {a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of aweapon}
H3857: properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H7291: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
H926: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H2659: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H905: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H5945: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
